detailZones.title: Primary monitor and mount
detailZones.description: Inspect the blank primary monitor, display frame, mounting arm, cable bundle and accessory shelf.

detailZones.title: Headwall service column
detailZones.description: Explore the visible service column, gas outlets, electrical sockets, nurse-call handset, task light and shelf.

detailZones.title: Pump rack and airway equipment
detailZones.description: Follow the four pump modules, mounting rack, ventilator, blank screens, breathing tubes and humidifier chamber.

detailZones.title: Bed and handset
detailZones.description: Inspect the empty ICU bed, mattress, pillow, rails, handset, frame, caster and overbed table.

detailZones.title: Portable support equipment
detailZones.description: Explore the transparent suction canister, transport monitor, IV pole, oxygen cylinder and visible support hardware.

detailZones.title: Rear bay and clinical cart
detailZones.description: Follow the glazed rear bay, rear bed and monitor, ceiling services, corridor floor and drawer cart.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized bedside-monitor photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 150 independently pointable monitor, service-column, pump, airway, bed, portable-equipment and room-fixture parts across 6 bounded zones. Patient identity, diagnoses, physiological readings, treatment advice, medication names, hidden device functions, brands, readable screen content and signage were excluded.
